label: No unexplained absence at roots, from own-nature exclusion and own-nature carriage (inference)
rule: An excluding condition of the root's own nature fails at the admissible extension, which own-nature carriage with member grounding's necessity direction forbids
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a determination d it lacks while an admissible q contains its determinations and d. A condition of r's own nature fails at every profile containing r's determinations and d, so at q. The necessity direction of member grounding makes q exclusion-free, so no determination of r requires, as such, a lack within q, and own-nature carriage gives the condition at q: a contradiction. It is the own-nature counterpart of route 915d06fd and connects the unity derivations to E. It uses neither N nor EM. The main theorem uses no axioms.
